Obtained from the new Sea of Wonders located off of Candia in Chapter 2: Colossus. Three potential drops:

Memory Traverser's Hat
Memory Traverser's Coat
Memory Traverser's Boots

See their pages for further details. The remaining drops will no doubt be entered when Chapter 2 is released on September 4th. Cheers.
